info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List It Management Production Releases-spec
info.description: The IT Management Production Releases API enables users to access and manage production releases for IT management within the banking sector. This endpoint provides detailed information on all current production releases, allowing teams to ensure optimal oversight and operational readiness. Typical consumers include IT managers and operations teams looking to track changes and updates in the production environment. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their release management processes and improve service delivery.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the current production release, including its version, release date, and any associated notes. It is useful for tracking release statuses in the IT management workflow.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching production release information. This should include any necessary parameters required by the endpoint in the specified schema format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the production release data.

ListItManagementProductionReleasesReques.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to production releases in the IT management system.
